entry.name: 다크 나이트
entry.identity_basis: Actual existing target20 PNG shows rounded plate helmet, broad shoulders, long black cape, red central lining/panel and a long sword without a large shield. These distinguishing features match body3054, not shield/spear body110. Explicit source2 black knight definition and sword-family collection context corroborate the actual pixels. Eight-heading idle/walk/attack and fixed boot/hem support directly reviewed; one exact source2 variant only.
entry.direction_review: h1 back = N; h5 chest/front = S; h3 profile right = E; h7 profile left = W; all diagonal views checked.
entry.foot_review: Fixed support/ground projection reviewed from actual idle and walking pixels; model-specific physical features are described in identity_basis. Same anchor across all files; no per-frame bbox recentering. Target actor root and existing 0.90 horizontal display factor preserved.

entry.timing_policy: Preserve target duration, markers, movement cadence and hit clocks; source durations recorded raw only.
entry.composition_limits: Offline opaque RLE; palette/t/blend/color keys and separate shadow composition not certified. No replacement attachment added.

matching_features: rounded grey plate helmet and broad shoulder armor
long black cape with central red lining/panel
one long sword and no large shield
target_image_identity_review.rejected_body110: Actual body110 has a large shield and long spear. It matches the separately identified ordinary 흑기사46, not the target20 sword/cape pixels.

page_evidence.observed: Separate Dark Knight entry; sword-master collection with Silver Knight, Sword Master and Arc Knight.
Separate ordinary black-knight entry; spear collections with skeleton spear and Dudamara orc.

target_image_identity_review.decision: Same character/form supported by actual distinguishing armor/cape/weapon pixels, explicit local body3054 black-knight definition and separate sword/spear collection context. Collection membership alone was not sufficient.
target_image_identity_review.candidate_override_scope: Only target20: replace its earlier bilingual-name-only body110 candidate with the actually reviewed body3054. Do not broaden any other candidate or merge variants.
